name: One Control
dirt_evidence: Anodized Brown Distortion; Baby Blue OD; Baltic Blue Fuzz; Cranberry OD; Golden Acorn; Honey Bee OD; Persian Green Screamer; Purple Plexifier; Rebel Red Distortion; Rocket Grey Fuzz; Silver Bee OD
notes: Timeline says pedal making began 11 Mar 2010; first sale was Mosquite Blender in Sep 2010; BJF collaboration begins with BJF Buffer in Jan 2012. Keep BJF as designer relationship, not separate One Control manufacturer.

name: Dreadbox
dirt_evidence: Disorder; Buzz; Jellyfish and later dirt/hybrid products
notes: Athens synth/effects builder. Disorder is a documented analog fuzz/filter product with distinct V1/V2 states. Broader Dreadbox catalog requires full catalog audit before completion.

name: EC Pedals / EC Custom Shop
dirt_evidence: Angry Ape; Muff's Head; Michael Benson FuzzDriver; Orphaned Drive; Overlord; Overlord Bass Overdrive; Primestortion; Rusty Cooley Overdrive; Zombie Distortion
notes: Eldar Cohen. Company started late 2010 with five-pedal line including two distortions, a bass fuzz and an overdrive. Later signature models remain distinct relationships.

name: Erafuzz
dirt_evidence: Buzzaround; Grand Dragon; Italian V; Civil War; Revolution; Sacred Resonance; Octavo Stone; LeBasse; RAM
notes: Rex Thornton. Exceptionally clean dated timeline from prototype through first products. Strong historical target because the builder chronology is explicit.

name: Analog Alien
dirt_evidence: FuzzBubble-45; Alien Twister; Tone Dragon and later gain products
notes: Jack and Joe Napoli. FuzzBubble-45 prototype Dec 2009, public release Sep 2010; Alien Twister released Apr 2012. Built in-house, professionally fabricated boards/enclosures, hand wiring.

name: Fromel Electronics
dirt_evidence: D.I.G.; Death Is Gain; Phuz Ge; Phuz Si; Velvet Vice
notes: John Fromel. First pedal 2008; company expanded from home workshop into retail/manufacturing location in 2010. Indexed catalog includes OD, distortion and two fuzz families.

name: Ben Adrian Audio
dirt_evidence: Bunny Drive; Fuzzy Bunny; Kowloon Walled Bunny
notes: Ben Adrian. First pedal under his own name in 2008; KWB developed 2009; commercial production halted after Line 6 employment in 2011. Preserve as a short-lived but well-documented builder.

name: RogerThat
dirt_evidence: Distortion DX; Distortion; Distortion Deluxe; Fuzz; Overdrive; Bass OD/DIS
notes: Rogier van Oudheusden. Started late 2009, company founded Jan 2010, first pedal line early 2011 with Distortion DX. Repairs/custom work preceded standardized products.

name: Moody Sounds
dirt_evidence: Zeygot Fuzz; Hjärt Müller Bass Drive
notes: Albin Roslund / Dennis Cederstrand lineage. First Moody Mushroom pedal Mar 2009; international assembled-pedal retail from Jun 2009; Zeygot Fuzz and bass drive belong in dirt census, but exact product dates need further work.

name: JMK Pedals
notes: Jacob Kokura. Modified first pedal 2006; first pedal sale 2009; released pedal line and website in 2011; PCB business followed in 2012. Small builder with unusually explicit transition chronology.

name: JerroStomp
dirt_evidence: Fuzzy Sunday; Hot Fudge Sundae; Fuzzo; Salamander; Fuzz Mace; Uppity Pup
notes: Jerry Ernst. Began kits/breadboarding Jan 2012; Fuzzy Sunday market-ready Jun 2012; Hot Fudge and Fuzzo followed from modifications in 2013; business stopped in 2016. Tiny-run history should be preserved.

name: Purdy Tube Amps-FX
notes: Edmonton builder. Effects Database identifies Fuzz as first pedal and indexes a 12-product catalog including dedicated OD and distortion. Founding chronology remains to be established.
